west-1915.note: German front of January 1915, unchanged in outline until July 1916 (wf-1915-16 red line)

west-1916.note: German front of 18 November 1916 after the Somme (wf-1915-16 dotted line 11/1916 between Bapaume and Chaulnes), the January 1915 line elsewhere

west-1917.note: German front after the withdrawal to the Hindenburg Line, 5 April 1917 (wf-1917 red line), kept to March 1918

west-1918.note: Front at the armistice, 11 November 1918 (wf-1918 dashed line 11/11/1918; south of Etain the line held since the St Mihiel offensive)

west-1914-09.note: Western limit and southern front of the German advance on 9 September 1914 (wf-1914): the line of the race to the sea north of Noyon, the Allied line on the Ourcq of 9 September (blue), the German line on the Marne from Montmirail to Revigny and Verdun, and the Lorraine front; the two gaps of the battle (Noyon-Ourcq, Meaux-Montmirail) are joined straight

east-prussia-1914-09.note: Russian 1st Army front in East Prussia on 10 September 1914 (ef-1914 blue dashed line); north of Wehlau continued straight to the Curonian Lagoon

poland-1915-west.note: Russian front in Poland and Galicia, 7 February 1915, unchanged since mid-December 1914 (ef-1915 blue line): area west of it

poland-1915-east.note: The same line: area east of it (Russian-held Galicia)

east-prussia-1915.note: German front in East Prussia on 7 February 1915, held since November 1914 (ef-1915 red line): Russian-held area east of it

east-1917-01.note: Eastern front of 1 January 1917 from the Gulf of Riga to the Danube delta (wp-1917 blue line "1 Jan")

east-1915-12-west.note: Eastern front after the Great Retreat, autumn 1915 to June 1916: Riga-Dvinsk-Pinsk from wp-1917 (unchanged until September 1917), Pinsk to the Romanian border from ef-1916 (March 1916 line); area west of it

east-1915-12-east.note: The same line: area east of it

east-1917-01-east.note: The 1 January 1917 line: area east of it

east-1917-12-west.note: Eastern front at the armistice of 15 December 1917: limit of the German advance at Riga, 5 September 1917 (riga-1917; north of Hinzenburg continued straight down the Livonian Aa to the sea), the Dvina line to Dvinsk and the line to Brody (wp-1917, 1 January 1917, unchanged), the line after the failed Kerensky offensive, 3 August 1917, from Brody to the Romanian border (wp-1917 dotted), the Romanian front (wp-1917, unchanged since January 1917); area west of it

east-1917-12-east.note: The same line: area east of it

italy-1917-10-south.note: Italian front on 24 October 1917 from the Stelvio to the sea at Monfalcone (caporetto, navy line); stands for the front of December 1915 and December 1916 too (Gorizia, August 1916, and the Asiago fighting of 1916 move it by less than 20 km): area south and west of it

italy-1917-11-north.note: Front after Caporetto, 12 November 1917 (caporetto, navy dash-dot line from the Asiago plateau along the Monte Grappa and the Piave to the sea), with the line of 24 October west of Asiago: area north and east of it

palestine-1917-12.note: Ottoman front north of Jerusalem, 30 December 1917 (palestine-1917, red dotted line "30 Dec"), from Et Tire to the Jordan valley; joined straight to the coast at the Auja mouth (off the map); area south of it to the Sinai

palestine-1918.note: British front in Palestine from the coast north of Jaffa to the Jordan near Jericho, held from March to 19 September 1918 (palestine-1918, solid red line "0415 19 Sept."); area south of it
